## Reproduction files

The three files needed to reproduce: https://gist.github.com/mtsgrd/268e10a9e3310d255343e0ec809ababb

```sh
# Download and test with git (clean merge)
git merge-file -p ours.svelte base.svelte theirs.svelte
echo "exit: $?"
# Expected: exit 0, no conflicts

# Compare: gix merge with Myers vs Histogram
# Myers: Resolution::Conflict (false positive)
# Histogram: Resolution::Complete (correct)
```
@Byron I've been debugging this issue since last night. I have been thinking it's the hunk locking algorithm that was at fault, but claude kept insisting it the amend I was attempting should succeed in git terms. Could you have a quick look at the above and let me know if the conclusion is valid?
